simple.meaning: לוּן (lûwn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently ; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 87 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 16 more, beginning at Genesis 19:2. Its contexts include family, family line, sacrifice, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּן (H3885).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לוּן (lûwn) / H3885 is traced through Genesis 19:2, Genesis 24:23, Genesis 24:25, Genesis 24:54 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently ; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
definitions.usage: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).
